meta.name: sleek-design-mobile-apps
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design a mobile app or UI screens, when they mention their Sleek (sleek.design) projects, or when implementing Sleek designs in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计移动应用界面并落地为代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在设计移动应用界面并想用代码实现它
copy.tagline_en: Design mobile app UI and implement it in code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you design mobile app interfaces and want to implement them in code.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的设计需求转成文字消息发给 Sleek 在线工具，取回渲染好的屏幕截图和配套 HTML 代码展示给你；若你要求写代码实现，它还会拉取各屏幕的 HTML 与截图作为编程参考。
howto.when: 当你想设计移动 App 或 UI 界面、提到自己的 Sleek 项目、或要求把 Sleek 设计用代码实现（HTML、React Native、SwiftUI）时触发；需要先设置 SLEEK_API_KEY。

say.text: 用 Sleek 帮我设计一个记账 App 的首页
say.note: 会创建项目并生成屏幕截图。

say.text: 把这个页面的配色改成浅色主题
say.note: 会向该项目发一条调整消息。

say.text: 给我这个屏幕的 React Native 代码
say.note: 会获取组件 HTML 作参考。

howto.what_en: Claude calls the Sleek API to turn your design request into a chat message, creates a project, fetches rendered screenshots and component HTML, and shows them to you. For code implementation, it also retrieves the HTML and screenshots as reference.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to design a mobile app or UI screens, mention your Sleek project, or implement Sleek designs in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI). Needs the SLEEK_API_KEY environment variable.

say_en.text: Design a home screen for a budgeting app in Sleek.
say_en.note: Creates a project and renders screenshots.

say_en.text: Change this screen to a light color theme.
say_en.note: Sends an edit message to the project.

say_en.text: Give me the React Native code for this screen.
say_en.note: Fetches the component HTML as reference.
